dimensions.assessment: Affects all participants and beneficiaries with employer-sponsored or individual health insurance who have newborns.
dimensions.evidence: provide coverage to a newborn of such parent for a 30-day period after the date of the birth of such newborn

dimensions.assessment: Ensures newborns receive mandatory temporary health coverage and prevents surprise medical bills during the initial postpartum period.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies federal health insurance statutes (PHSA, ERISA, IRC) to impose uniform mandatory coverage and notification rules on health plans.
dimensions.evidence: A group health plan, and a health insurance issuer offering group or individual health insurance coverage, shall... provide coverage to a newborn

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to plan years beginning on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to plan years beginning on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: Amends the PHSA, ERISA, and the Internal Revenue Code to mandate that group and individual health plans provide 30 days of newborn coverage, a 60-day special enrollment period, and immediate non-enrollment notifications.
